name: Global Dining Holdings Limited
summary: Singapore Food Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding company, primarily engaged in the creation and retail of bakery and confectionery items. The company's operations are distinctly divided into two core segments: the sale of bakery products and the management of restaurants. Its bakery offerings encompass a variety of goods, such as breads, pizzas, and cakes. As of June 30, 2021, Singapore Food Holdings maintained a substantial presence, with 18 dedicated bakery outlets. Its restaurant portfolio was diverse, featuring five Japanese fast-casual dining establishments, one Western fast-casual restaurant, three Chinese fast-casual dining spots, and a single beverage kiosk. These ventures operate under several distinct brands, including Proofer, 300BC, Yuba Hut, and Laura. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong. Singapore Food Holdings Ltd. itself functions as a subsidiary of AA Food Holdings Limited.
